The column is named here from the heading that IS printed, never inferred. WHAT PROVES IT: TWO GRAINS OF THE SAME TABLE CHECKED AGAINST THE SAME PRINTED Total Omnibus. (2) `voted` -- the 92 line items sum to $38,600,831.30, which is $542,667.00 OVER, and that residual is ATTESTED rather than tolerated because it is wholly and exactly accounted for by two places where THE TOWN'S OWN PRINTED FIGURES DISAGREE WITH EACH OTHER. SIXTEEN of the eighteen printed group totals foot their own line items TO THE CENT, Total Protection foots its four subtotals exactly and Total Assistance foots its two exactly. THE TWO THAT DO NOT. Both were read at 400 dpi off the page's own bitmap and both are as printed. The grand total is footed on the $60,303.00 version. WHICH OF THE TWO THE TOWN MEANT IS NOT ESTABLISHED HERE. (b) p162 prints `43 Fire Department $1,093,374.24`, `43A Capital - Fire Dept. $20,000.00`, `44 Fire Hydrant Expense $15,000.00` and `45 Radio Equipment Mtc. $10,000.00`, footing to $1,138,374.24, and then `Subtotal Fire Dept. $1,138,434.24` -- $60.00 more than its own four lines. NEITHER IS A TOLERANCE and neither is OUR reading failing -- both are named here and in table-corrections.csv.
